thesis: The science supports a positive readout: Phase 3 LoA sits above the oncology mean and two structurally similar prior readouts hit their primary endpoint.

key_findings.claim: Phase 3 LoA for this indication/phase pair is materially above the oncology mean.
Two structurally similar prior readouts hit their primary endpoint.

disease_unmet_need.unmet_need_severity: high — median OS under 12 months on SoC

efficacy.context_vs_benchmark: HR 0.68 is a ~32% risk reduction, above the ~20% ASCO clearly-meaningful bar

prior_consistency: Phase 3 HR 0.68 is broadly consistent with the Phase 2 signal (HR ~0.6), a modest expected regression to the mean.
key_scientific_risk: The open-label design can inflate the investigator-assessed PFS endpoint; an OS confirmation is not yet available.
